causes/food-nutrition-for-families: Why Nutrition Matters
Why Skills and Jobs Matter

Nutritious food is one of the most basic human needs, yet many families continue to face hunger and food insecurity every day. Proper nutrition is essential for healthy growth, energy, and overall well-being.
A certificate and a first interview matter more than another relief packet. Rozgar Desk trains youth so they can earn, not wait.
For children, access to healthy meals directly impacts learning, development, and long-term health. Without proper nutrition, families struggle to build stable and healthy lives.
Without a skill, interview practice, or an employer who will listen, school-leavers stall. We close that gap batch by batch.
The Reality of Hunger
The Reality of Unemployment
Many families are forced to choose between food and other basic necessities. Rising costs and limited resources make it difficult for vulnerable communities to access balanced meals regularly.
Many young people still leave school without a skill certificate or interview practice — and migrate blindly or sit idle.
Food insecurity affects not only physical health but also emotional and mental well-being. Hunger limits opportunities and creates long-term challenges for families.
Joblessness drains confidence. A rozgar mela, a CV review, and one local employer can restart a plan.
Our Commitment to Support
Our Commitment to Work

Our mission is to provide nutritious meals and food supplies to families facing difficult circumstances. Through food distribution programs and community support initiatives, we help reduce hunger and improve daily living conditions.
Rozgar & Skills Desk trains youth, hosts placement cells, and connects graduates to dignified work across Jharkhand and West Bengal.
We also focus on creating sustainable food support systems that help communities become more self-reliant over time.
We also build local employer trust so the next batch walks into a known workshop, not a cold listing.
Nourishing Communities Together
Placing Youth Together
A simple meal can bring hope, comfort, and strength to a family in need. By working together, we can help ensure that no family has to face hunger alone.
A first job can reset a household. By working together, we can make sure no youth in our blocks is left without a pathway.
Together, we can create healthier and stronger communities through nutrition and care.
Together, we can build stronger blocks through skills, placement, and follow-up.
causes/women-empowerment-for-rise: Empowering women creates stronger families, healthier communities, and better opportunities for future generations. When women have access to education, skills, and resources, they
When women and girls are safe, skilled, and heard, families hold together and girls stay in school. Nari Suraksha Desk starts with safety, then livelihood.
Our Approach to Safety and Dignity
When women rise, entire communities benefit. Empowered women inspire future generations, contribute to local economies, and help create positive social change.
When a girl finishes a batch and a woman knows her rights, the whole panchayat shifts — safety first, dignity always.
causes/water-sanitation-for-health: We provide clean drinking water and improved sanitation facilities to promote healthier living conditions in communities.
Janajati Sahyog & Kheti Desk stands with tribal hamlets — farm inputs, market links, and seasonal planning so kheti income survives a bad monsoon.
Access to clean water and proper sanitation is essential for healthy living. Safe water reduces the spread of diseases, improves hygiene, and supports overall community well-being.
Land dignity, fair prices, and youth who do not have to migrate blindly — that is tribal welfare with a ledger, not a slogan.
Yet, many communities still lack access to reliable clean water sources and sanitation facilities.
Yet many janajati farmers still sell at distress rates without storage, advice, or collective bargaining.
The Challenges Communities Face
The Challenges Hamlets Face
Unsafe drinking water and poor sanitation continue to create serious health risks for families. Children are especially vulnerable to waterborne diseases caused by contaminated water sources.
A bad monsoon, a middleman, or a missing seed kit can wipe a season. We plan with hamlets before the rain, not after the loss.
Limited sanitation facilities also impact education, health, and daily living conditions within communities.
Limited market access also pushes youth out of the block before they finish a skill.
Our Commitment to Change
Our Commitment to Hamlets

We work to improve access to clean drinking water and proper sanitation facilities in underserved areas. Through awareness programs and infrastructure support, we help communities build healthier environments.
We work on farm inputs, fair markets, and seasonal resilience — so janajati families keep land, income, and dignity.
Our initiatives focus on long-term solutions that improve hygiene, health, and quality of life.
Our work focuses on long-term farm income, not one-off relief drops.
Building Healthier Communities
Standing With Hamlets
Clean water changes lives. It improves health, supports education, and creates safer environments for families and children.
Fair kheti income changes lives. It keeps youth in the block and students in class.

In our blocks, camps are far, costs are unclear, and follow-up is missing. Swasthya Desk brings care closer to home — camps, referrals, and medicines families can actually reach.
